description: Runs the ROI calculator published on the site, with exactly its formulas and bounds. Use it when the buyer asks what the product would bring them: deals won, revenue, time saved. Call it without values to get its inputs (label, bounds, default), ask the buyer for their own figures, then pass x1, x2… Returns each result with its calculation, the inputs used, the published assumptions and the page to quote. For a price, use devis; for a published statistic, citer_chiffre.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

x1.description: Proposals sent per month, whole team (proposals): 1 to 200, default 10.

x3.description: Average signed deal value (€ excl. VAT): 0 to 1000000, step 5000, default 10000.

x5.description: Number of sales reps (sales reps): 1 to 50, default 1.

name: calculer_roi
title: Estimate the return on investment
